senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced. art.) limping, lame. Sifra Emor ch. II, Par. 3 פ׳ בין חגר וכ׳ ‘lame’ (Lev. XXI, 18), whether lame on both feet or on one.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 126:2">Sifré Deut. 126</cite>; a. e.—Pl. <he>פִּסְּחִים</he>, <cite ref="Q00061"><he>פִּי׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 36:2">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXVI</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 5:6">II Sam. V, 6</cite>) <he>העורים והפ׳ אלו הצלמים</he> ‘the blind and the lame’ means the idols; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 82">Yalk. Gen. 82</cite> (with ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 115:5-7">Ps. CXV, 5-7</cite>).
